global_style: Dark-mode, sci-fi inspired presentation template featuring vibrant neon gradients, glassmorphic cards, and large spherical/organic focal elements.

identity_anchors: Deep space/dark void backgrounds paired with high-contrast neon highlights
Translucent 'glass' cards with thin glowing strokes
Vibrant purple-to-blue color transitions in shapes and typography
Oversized geometric typography interacting with spherical/organic background elements

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
